title: Authorizers
description: External OpenID AuthZEN 1.0 policy decision points (PDPs) that the gateway and identity can delegate authorization decisions to.

authorizers.title: authorizers
authorizers.description: Map of authorizer name → external AuthZEN 1.0 PDP configuration.

url.title: url
url.description: Base URL of an OpenID AuthZEN 1.0 PDP (`http://` or `https://`, optional path prefix without trailing slash, no credentials or query). Plat5 appends `/access/v1/evaluation` and `/access/v1/evaluations`.

timeout.title: timeout
timeout.description: HTTP timeout for each AuthZEN request, as a duration (`2s`). Default `2s`.

cache_ttl.title: cache_ttl
cache_ttl.description: How long the gateway caches positive (`decision: true`) answers from this authorizer (`0s` disables caching). Default `0s`.

negative_cache_ttl.title: negative_cache_ttl
negative_cache_ttl.description: How long the gateway caches negative (`decision: false`) answers from this authorizer (`0s` disables caching). Default `0s`.

token_env.title: token_env
token_env.description: Optional environment variable name on the gateway and identity holding a bearer token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <value>` to the PDP. Never put plaintext secrets in config.

non_negative_duration.title: non-negative duration
non_negative_duration.description: A whole number (`0` or positive) and a unit: `s`, `m`, `h` or `d`.

mode.title: mode
mode.description: How the external authorizer combines with Plat5's built-in RBAC: `replace` (default: PDP decides alone), `and` (Plat5 RBAC and PDP must both allow), or `or` (either Plat5 RBAC or PDP allows).

kind_authorizer.title: kind authorizer
kind_authorizer.description: External authorizer for this kind's `list_permission` filtering, identity `/access/v1/*` evaluation, and kind-scoped routes (unless overridden or opted out with `false`). Either an authorizer name (implies `mode: replace`) or `{ name, mode }`.

resource.title: resource
resource.description: Optional AuthZEN resource override for a route (`{ type, id }`). Defaults to the route's scope kind and leaf node id. `id` accepts `{<kind>.id}`, `{member.id}`, and route `{param}` placeholders.

route_authorizer.title: route authorizer
route_authorizer.description: External AuthZEN authorizer for a service, scope, route or verb (kind scopes only). Either an authorizer name (implies `mode: replace`), `false` to opt out of an inherited authorizer, or `{ name, mode?, resource?, action? }`.

action.title: action
action.description: Optional AuthZEN `action.name` override. Defaults to the route's `required_permissions`; required when `required_permissions` is `any_member`.
